quarterly_data.quarter: Novo Nordisk press release: Novo's investigational obesity and diabetes drug CagriSema (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CagriSema mechanistic data presented at EASD 2026: in a 52-week fMRI study in adults with overweight or obesity, CagriSema modified brain responses to high-calorie food cues, reduced 'food noise', cravings, hunger and appetite at 22 and 52 weeks, alongside a 22.4% reduction in body weight versus placebo at 52 weeks (p<0.0001); in an MRI sub-study of the phase 3a REIMAGINE 1 trial in early type 2 diabetes, CagriSema 2.4 mg/2.4 mg significantly reduced abdominal, liver and pancreas fat versus placebo with a 14.3% body-weight reduction at week 40; a post hoc bone-marker analysis of phase 3 REIMAGINE 2 showed signs of healthy balance in bone maintenance alongside a 14.2% body-weight reduction at week 68. The release adds that the CagriSema obesity NDA was submitted to Health Canada, as well as the US FDA, in December 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: fMRI study: 22.4% weight reduction vs placebo at 52 weeks (p<0.0001); REIMAGINE 1 MRI sub-study: 14.3% at week 40; REIMAGINE 2 bone analysis: 14.2% at week 68; NDA to Health Canada December 2025
